name: LexMakesIt

faq.services: LexMakesIt builds websites, custom apps, and A I tools for local businesses, like this phone receptionist. We also set up automations, like missed call text back and appointment reminders, and teach automation sessions. What kind of business do you have?
faq.price: Website design starts at one thousand dollars, plus ten dollars a month for management. Automation teaching sessions are one hundred dollars per session. Other projects are priced individually after a free conversation, which I can book for you.
faq.location: We're based in Paterson and serve Passaic County and North Jersey.
faq.contact: You can call or text five five one, two two seven, seven three zero six.
faq.get_started: The first step is a conversation, and the demo homepage is free. I can book a time for you to talk, or you can call or text five five one, two two seven, seven three zero six.
faq.payment: We don't do payment plans. To get started there's a fifty percent deposit, and the rest is due when the project is done.
